content: Deixis Deictic words or phrases, are referential expressions whose denotation depends on context. This includes personal deixis (“I”, “you”), place deixis (“here”, “there”), and discourse deixis, where parts of the discourse are referenced (“that's a good question”). The test set examples are all related to person deixis, specifically the T-V distinction between informal and formal you (Latin “tu” and “vos”) in the Russian translations, and test for consistency in this respect.
